Container.Name: openGym
Container.Overview: Self-hosted workout and body-weight tracker with routines, exercise animations, progress charts, passkeys and password login. Packages the openGym web UI and API together for Unraid; no separate database or Docker Compose required. Set Application URL to the exact browser address before creating a profile. HTTPS on a domain is required for passkeys on other devices; password login works over a trusted LAN. The first profile becomes the administrator. Back up the appdata folder.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: fitness gym workout exercise health weight training

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: HTTP port. Forward your HTTPS reverse proxy to this port.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: All profiles, workout data, uploads, session secret and push keys. Back up this folder.

Config.Name: Application URL
Config.Description: Required: exact address used in the browser, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8080 or https://gym.example.com. Include the port when using one; no trailing slash. Must match your chosen Web UI port.

Config.Name: Passkey hostname
Config.Description: Hostname only from Application URL, e.g. gym.example.com (no scheme, port or path). A LAN IP can be used with password login, but remote passkeys require HTTPS on a domain.

Config.Name: Password login
Config.Description: 1 enables username/password sign-in, including LAN HTTP access. 0 uses passkeys only.

Config.Name: First profile is administrator
Config.Description: 1 makes the first profile on an empty instance the administrator. Create your profile before sharing access.

Config.Name: Invite-only registration
Config.Description: Set to 1 after creating the first administrator to require invite codes for new profiles.

Config.Name: Allow guest mode
Config.Description: 1 allows browser-only guest data; 0 requires a server profile. Guest data is not part of appdata backups.

Config.Name: Session duration
Config.Description: Days before a newly issued sign-in expires.

Config.Name: Language
Config.Description: Optional initial language, such as en, de or pt-BR.

Config.Name: URL prefix
Config.Description: Only for a reverse proxy that passes a prefix through: /gym, without a trailing slash. Leave empty for normal hosting or a proxy that strips its prefix.
